rationale: Price opened with a massive 29% gap up and has already faded significantly from the session high of $51.78 to $50.36, sitting at only 6.6% of today's range and well below both the session VWAP ($50.91) and the 9-EMA ($52.37), indicating sellers are in control after the gap.
